notes.note: Derkson wasn't able to post a 70+ score this week for those owners that have needed to use him.  He had just 9 touches with 3 tackles.
Derkson delivered another good score for those relying on him and he will be needed by more coaches this week as Nas is out and he may be the only bench cover. 16 touches at 93% is a handy
Derkson has now posted two good scores in a row and this week it was mostly due to his 11 intercept possessions. A handy backup for the injured Milera for some teams this week.
Derkson is on many benches and many coaches would have tried to loop him on this week with his best score. 18 touches and 8 marks.
Derkson had the 9 disposals at 77% and took 4 marks. He is a heartbeat on your bench but not much more than that at the moment.

Derkson came on to the field for a number of coaches that had Whitfield and unfortunately he didn't do what we hoped. This is the lowest we have seen from him this season from his 10 kicks and 3 handballs.
Derkson had just 11 disposals and 6 marks and he has been hanging around this level of scoring of late. He will be ok bench cover for us if he can keep this up.

Derksen got off to a hot start with 36 in the first term but just 3 in the second and -1 in the last was disappointing for owners. His score was still good enough to keep his BE negative and with the lack of cash generation yet he is one to hold through the Blues bye if you can.
Derksen played his third game and it was his best score of the season. His value rose and his BE remains low at -21. Not too late to get him in if you need him.
Derksen played his first game and posted 11 disposals and 4 marks. It wasn't a score that made us say we have to pick him but if he can do it
